name: ViCrit-Bench
description: ViCrit-Bench is a benchmark for evaluating vision–language models on their ability to critique, analyze, and provide reasoned feedback about images. It contains image–text examples with tasks that require identifying issues, biases, or descriptive inaccuracies and producing either multiple-choice judgments or free-form critiques. The benchmark is intended to measure models' multimodal reasoning and critical analysis capabilities rather than pure recognition accuracy.
reputation: A niche Hugging Face dataset with limited but growing use in multimodal evaluation studies.
